name: Oldenburg in Holstein (Germany)
description: Blue field charged with the figures of the city arms of Oldenburg in Holstein: a yellow castle beneath a small white shield with a red nettle leaf.
history: Municipal flag of Oldenburg in Holstein; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: small shield with red nettle leaf
